data.one_liner: A text field widget that supports automatic date formatting and date picking.
data.what_it_does: Provides a DateFormatField widget that automatically formats date inputs as users type based on predefined styles. It supports separator addition, keyboard setting, and includes an optional calendar icon for a date selection modal.
use_when: You need a text field specifically tailored for manual date entry with automatic formatting
You want an integrated calendar picker icon next to a date text field
avoid_when: You need complex form validation libraries beyond basic date completion
You require fully custom input masks that do not fit the 4 predefined date format types
strengths: Supports multiple date formatting options with automatic separators
Includes an optional built-in calendar picker modal
Compatible with standard InputDecoration for easy styling
weaknesses: Limited to four specific date format types
Only handles date formatting, not general input masks
